name: Rosemary Chicken Thighs with Roasted Winter Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Position rack in the center.

Slice carrots diagonally into ¼ inch thick pieces and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Peel turnips, halve lengthwise, slice crosswise into ¼ inch thick half rounds, and add to pan. Halve potatoes lengthwise, slice crosswise into ¼ inch thick half rounds, and add to pan. Peel onion, cut into thin wedges, and add to pan.
Place pan in the oven and begin roasting vegetables while you prepare the sauce and chicken, about 10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash rosemary and slide leaves off most of the stems (leave a couple stems for garnishing).
In medium bowl, prepare sauce by combining garlic, rosemary leaves, olive oil, Dijon, thyme, salt, and pepper.

Remove pan from oven. Place chicken thighs over top vegetables. Drizzle sauce over top and toss chicken and vegetables until well coated. Then return to oven and roast until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Remove pan from oven. Change oven setting to broil and position rack about 6 inches from the top. Return pan to oven and broil until chicken and vegetables are lightly golden, 2-3 minutes.
Place vegetables and chicken thighs on a plate. Garnish with remaining rosemary stems and enjoy!
author: Mealime
